name: sepia-mcp
description: Self-contained MCP server for Sepia — a personal knowledge-graph memory server. Talks to the Sepia REST API (SEPIA_URL + SEPIA_API_KEY); stdio or HTTP transport.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target=node --outdir=dist --external tmcp --external @tmcp/transport-http --external valibot && chmod +x dist/index.js
